synth.notes:
Twin 4x4 colour-10 blocks: A1/A2 move y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together (mirrored by half), each only if dest 4x4 is floor colour 5 within rows 1-62.
Click inactive marker (9) arms: blocks -> players (1), clicked marker -> active (11); clicking a player disarms; other clicks and A5 are no-ops.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker 4x4 cell (marker xy-1) by 4 unmirrored, same floor guard.
HUD: colour-0 bars in row 0 (from right) and row 63 (from left), width round(64a/150), a = actions this level incl. no-ops, recovered from a memo of recent returned frames (fallback: largest a for that width).
Unconfirmed: bar law beyond observed widths, behaviour on level completion.
